messages:
Maya: Heads-up — CI is flapping on the embeddings contract tests. Seems the embed endpoint sometimes returns a single object for a single input, breaking the SDKs that expect a list.
Sam: Yup, saw the failure. PR #482 changed the shape: when input is a string we return {embedding: [...]}, previously we always returned [ {embedding: [...]} ].
Liam: That will cause a lot of client churn. Is truncation also implicated in the failing test (the input was ~20k chars)?
Alex: Truncation is token-based per-model using our tokenizer. Right now we silently truncate to the model's max_input_tokens for embeddings and don't emit a warning header or body warning.
Priya: Proposal: (1) restore always-list response semantics (backwards compatible), (2) add optional "warnings" array in the response body for things like truncation, and (3) emit a response header `X-Redwood-Embedding-Truncated: true` when truncation happened. We can mark header as opt-in for older clients.
Sam: Strong +1. Also enforce server-side limits: max_batch_items = 2048 and max_total_tokens = 1_000_000 per request, and add regression tests for both shapes.
Maya: Who will own the server-side fix vs SDK tolerance? We need a short rollout plan so we don't break prod clients again.
Liam: I can own the server PR — will revert the single-object shortcut and add a `warnings` field + header. I'll gate behind a feature-flag `embed_consistent_list` so we can flip safely.
Alex: I'll update model catalog docs with per-model token caps and add an example curl snippet illustrating both single-input -> list response and batch response. Example:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hello"}'`
Expected body after fix:
`{"data": [{"embedding": [0.01, -0.02, ...]}], "warnings": []}`
Priya: I will update Node/Python SDKs to tolerate both shapes for two minor releases and then remove the compatibility shim once server is stable. Also adding an analytics counter `embedding.truncated_count` is useful.
infra-bot: CI: embedding-contract-tests failed (embed-consistency) — 1/5 failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/xyz
Sam: I'll add unit + integration tests that assert response is always a list in both single and batch cases; include truncation test for long strings.
Maya: OK action items: Liam = server PR (revert + warnings + header + feature flag), Sam = tests, Priya = SDK updates, Alex = docs + model caps, Maya = create tracking ticket and coordinate rollout. Ping here when PRs are open. :thumbsup:
